Senses.Note: The allowlisted concordance has 418 matches in 147 texts. The retained set covers direct comparisons and answers using the bare worn-out-sandals headword. Family revalidation confirms one object sense; the wear-out-sandals verb phrase is related but denotes an action involving that object.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖師玄旨是破草鞋。寧可赤脚不著最好。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), Huangbo Xiyun says the patriarchs’ dark purport is worn-out straw sandals and going barefoot is best.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問。如何是道。師曰。破草鞋。與拋向湖裏著。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Compendium of the Five Lamps (五燈會元), Jiashan Shanhui answers “What is the Way?” with worn-out straw sandals and tells the questioner to throw them in the lake.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰屋裏有一緉破草鞋
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Fragments of the Jade Flowers Collection of Lamp Records (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）), Bajiao Huiqing answers that inside the house is a pair of worn-out straw sandals.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖師玄旨是破草鞋，寧可赤腳不著最好。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Ancestral Hall Collection (祖堂集), Huangbo Xiyun calls the patriarchs’ dark purport worn-out straw sandals.

Occurrences.Kwic: 會淂亇中意當甚破草鞋
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Foguo (佛國禪師語錄), Foguo asks what worn-out straw sandals are worth once the matter is understood.

Occurrences.Kwic: 縱然親睹明星現，也是街頭破草鞋。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Weian Deran (松隱唯菴然和尚語錄), Weian Deran says even personally seeing the morning star is street-side worn-out straw sandals.

Occurrences.Kwic: 秪有半隻破草鞋，無底無根亦無對。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Wuchu Daguan (無趣老人語錄), Wuchu Daguan says he has only half a soleless, unmatched worn-out straw sandal.

Senses.Explanation: Worn-out straw sandals are damaged travel footwear fit to discard; Chan speakers make the contemptuous object an answer or comparison for formulations, accomplishments, and lineage emblems that someone is still carrying. Huangbo Xiyun calls the patriarchs' dark purport worn-out straw sandals; Jiashan Shanhui answers 'What is the Way?' with them and says to throw them into the lake. Bajiao Huiqing locates a pair inside the house, Foguo asks what they are worth after the matter is understood, Weian Deran calls even seeing the morning star street-side worn-out sandals, and Wuchu Daguan has half a soleless sandal. These are deployments of the bare worn-out-sandals headword; the different wear-out-the-sandals predicate is routed to family evidence.
